reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing shouldWriteMonthBudget predicate and reuses the shared extractTagsFromText tag parser, but does not consolidate the six category queries that feed it.

duplication.why: The same `n.note AS group_notes` column and `LEFT JOIN notes n ON n.id = g.id` are pasted into six near-identical SQL queries instead of a shared query helper.

placement.why: The decision lives in month-action.ts, the module that already holds the month-wide category rules, with only data plumbing in actions.ts.

scope.why: Only the predicate, its type, the feeding queries and a test change.

maintainability.why: The rule is decided once and tested; the main cost is that every future column for the rule must again be added to six copied queries.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated join in getBudgetData, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg and set6MonthAvg is plainly repeated, not disguised.

one_place.where: server/budget/month-action.ts shouldWriteMonthBudget, called by every month-wide action in actions.ts; the queries only supply group_notes.
